t2.thesis: Dynatrace's fundamental momentum is strong, but a roughly 46% three-month run-up, a 12.5% implied move and wildly two-sided recent reactions leave this close to a coin flip, so I stay at the buy-everything base rate.
reasons: Q1 FY27 (I4) beat across all metrics, with organic net new ARR up 41% and four quarters of accelerating trailing-twelve-month net new ARR, which supports another beat-and-raise.
Expectations are elevated: the stock is up about 46% in three months and about 50% year to date (I17, I18), so a merely good print could still sell off.
The 10.6% five-day pullback (I2: A_ret_5d) has partly reset positioning before the print.
Recent reactions were +17%, -16%, +14.5% and +1.5% despite EPS beats of 5% to 8% every time, so the beat itself does not predict direction.
The 12.5% implied move with IV at 1.74x 60-day realized vol means a large binary outcome, and none of it tilts direction clearly.
t2.deciding_variable: Whether net new ARR keeps accelerating and full-year FY27 ARR guidance is raised by more than the beat, given FX headwinds and the high bar set by the run-up.

prior.from: I3 base rates: software_internet cluster t0_hit 0.541 and BMO session 0.548 (overall ~0.54)

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. November 3, 2026 is still in the future (today is October 30, 2026), so Dynatrace (DT) hasn't reported those earnings yet and there's no stock reaction to describe.
t2.moved_from_prior: Net about -0.005. Business momentum and the bullish sell-side previews (I19, I20, I21) add roughly +0.02. The stretched three-month run and high expectations subtract roughly -0.025. The recent pullback and mildly call-rich ATM IV (I2: B_iv_spread +0.03) roughly offset each other.

theses.mechanism: Net new ARR growth accelerates again, logs and AI consumption beat, and the full-year ARR/revenue guide rises beyond the Q2 beat.
theses.wrong_if: The guide raise is only the beat flow-through or ARR growth is flat at 17%.

theses.mechanism: After the big run, an in-line ARR result or FX-driven guide trim triggers profit-taking, similar to the May print (-16%).
theses.wrong_if: ARR growth reaches 18% or more with a clear constant-currency raise.

theses.mechanism: A solid beat is already priced in, and the recent 10% pullback offsets disappointment-driven selling.
theses.wrong_if: Net retention or new-logo commentary materially surprises in either direction.

key_observations: Total ARR growth (17% last quarter) and organic net new ARR growth versus the 41% in Q1
Full-year FY27 ARR guide versus $2,359M to $2,379M, on both constant-currency and as-reported bases
Annualized logs consumption versus $200M and AI-related commentary
Q2 revenue versus the $565M to $570M guide and EPS versus 0.49 consensus
Any CFO appointment news or changes to buyback and capital-allocation commentary
